title: Mario Party Superstars
subtitle: The old boards return to the table
summary: Mario Party Superstars is NDcube's Switch collection of remade boards and minigames, released on 29 October 2021.
body: Mario Party Superstars is NDcube's Switch collection of remade boards and minigames, released on 29 October 2021. Five boards from the Nintendo 64 trilogy return alongside one hundred short games drawn from the series' past. Four competitors move independently, earn coins and purchase Stars, giving the package the structure of the earlier entries. Its selection makes the gathering a playable retrospective: a familiar map can bring back remembered rivalries, while a player encountering it for the first time faces the same clearly defined contest.

Peach's Birthday Cake, Yoshi's Tropical Island, Space Land, Horror Land and Woody Woods each retain a distinctive arrangement of routes and events. Items and dice rolls change the journey towards a Star, while a minigame after each round replenishes the coins that make another purchase possible. The hundred-game selection shifts rapidly between solo, paired and uneven teams. Button-based controls allow the collection to be played with different Switch controllers, keeping the rules of each challenge more important than a particular motion-control accessory.

Online play gives the classic board format a way to bring together a group beyond the same room, while the remade presentation connects the old layouts to Switch's visual style. Masayoshi Ishi, Toshiki Aida and Satoshi Okubo composed the music. Superstars treats the series' history as material for another social occasion rather than simply a list of remembered titles. The familiar rules remain active because another person's decisions, a changing item supply and an unexpected minigame can still redirect the outcome of an old board.
